podcast.body: This record, released in 1996, was Sparklehorse's debut album and featured their only alt-rock hit, "Sunday I Will Treat You Good." The album's success led to Sparklehorse being invited on a European tour with Radiohead, an event that unfortunately marked a turning point for frontman Mark Linkous. "In 1996, Sparkle Horse released a record called Viva Dixie Submarine Transmission Plot."
